newsitem.title: BELGIUM: AEA Nov 96 cargo data shows rises for all routes.
newsitem.headline: AEA Nov 96 cargo data shows rises for all routes.

text.p: The Association of European Airlines (AEA) air cargo figures for November 1996, showed volume increases for all markets, an AEA statement said.

It added that two market sectors; Europe-North Africa/Middle East and the South Atlantic trade saw the largest increases in November revenue freight tonne kilometres, up by 19.7 percent to 92.8m RTFK and 11 percent up to 125.2m RTFK respectively.

However, the Europe-Sub Saharan Africa trade and the North Atlantic saw only saw slight rises of 0.2 percent to 166.2m RTFK and a 0.5 percent to 714.1m RTFK for November 1996, compared to the same month in 1995.
